## Blog

- [3D Printing Materials After a PLA Clamp Fails](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printing-materials-after-pla-clamp-fails.html): Choose a replacement material from the failed part's heat, load, motion, and fit requirements. Includes a 65°C clamp check.
- [3D Printing Rates: Price a Small Job Step by Step](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printing-rates-small-job-pricing.html): Calculate 3D printing rates from material, print time, electricity, labor, machine time, failures, and margin. Includes a two-part example.
- [3D Scanning to Printing: Repair, Scale, Slice](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-scanning-to-printing-repair-scale-slice.html): Turn a 3D scan into a printable file: repair the mesh, set scale from a known dimension, verify thin areas, and slice a measured test.
- [Best 3D Printing Websites for Files: 2026 Guide](https://moorecode.com/blog/best-3d-printing-websites-files-2026.html): Compare five 3D printing websites for free files, print profiles, miniatures, search, and commercial-use licenses.
- [Desktop 3D Printing Setup: A Safe Beginner Workspace](https://moorecode.com/blog/desktop-3d-printing-setup-safe-workspace.html): Build a practical desktop 3D printing setup with the right space, ventilation, tools, storage, and FDM or resin workflow.
- [3D Printing a Prototype: Four Stages, One Test Plan](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printing-prototype-four-stage-test-plan.html): Choose a 3D printing process and material for visual, fit, functional, and pilot prototypes by starting with the test result.
- [3D Printing Materials Guide: PLA, PETG, TPU](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printing-filament-pla-petg-tpu.html): Compare common desktop 3D printing materials, then choose PLA, PETG, or TPU by the part, printer, and required properties.
- [Free blackjack basic strategy trainer for iPhone compared](https://moorecode.com/blog/free-blackjack-basic-strategy-trainer-iphone.html): Five free iPhone blackjack basic strategy trainers compared on ads, in-app purchases, and rule settings. One of them is my own app, Blackjack Now.
- [Mileage tracker for delivery drivers: IRS deduction rules](https://moorecode.com/blog/mileage-tracker-delivery-drivers-tax-deduction.html): Which delivery miles count as business miles, the 2026 IRS rate of 72.5 and 76 cents, and what a mileage log needs. Includes a worked example.
- [Invoicing app pricing for service businesses, compared](https://moorecode.com/blog/simple-invoicing-app-pricing-service-businesses.html): Pricing for five invoicing tools a small service business shortlists, with free-plan invoice limits and what 60 invoices a month cost on each.
- [What Is FDM 3D Printing? How It Works](https://moorecode.com/blog/what-is-fdm-3d-printing.html): FDM 3D printing melts filament and deposits it layer by layer. Learn the workflow, suitable parts, limits, and later comparison with SLA and SLS.
- [When Resin 3D Printing Beats FDM](https://moorecode.com/blog/when-resin-3d-printing-beats-fdm.html): Choose resin 3D printing for fine detail and smooth surfaces. Compare it with FDM, then plan the washing, curing, ventilation, and PPE.
- [3D Printmaking Checklist: Mirrored Art to Inked Proof](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printmaking-checklist-mirrored-art-inked-proof.html): Turn digital art into a 3D-printed relief plate. Use this practical checklist for mirroring, modeling, slicing, inking, and pulling a clean proof.
- [7 Fused Deposition Modelling Mistakes to Fix](https://moorecode.com/blog/fused-deposition-modelling-mistakes-to-fix.html): Fix seven common fused deposition modelling mistakes, from first-layer trouble and stringing to weak parts, excess speed, and poor ventilation.
- [3D Printing Metal: Four Processes Compared](https://moorecode.com/blog/3d-printing-metal-processes-compared.html): Compare metal powder bed fusion, binder jetting, metal FFF, and directed energy deposition by feedstock, finish, shrinkage, and best use.
